ChangeNotes.Value:
Changelog
Map - Map tracks are now synced and scouting can be levelled from spotting them.
Battles - Improved FPS during battles. - Made battle size configurable in the mod-options JSON file. Dedicated servers now respect the configured battle size instead of capping battles at 400 troops. - Nearby AI lords and armies can join player battles again. - Players can join the same nonempty field battle despite uneven troop reserves.
Sieges - AI siege armies no longer overestimate settlement defenses when co-op players are inside. - Starving AI siege armies now assault when viable or abandon the siege instead of rebuilding forever.
Saves - Co-op clients on Linux now continue past host save loading instead of getting stuck on the loading screen. - Loaded armies in one kingdom now disband correctly; each army can be managed separately.
Performance - Added configurable movement bandwidth limits and prioritized nearby agent movement when bandwidth is constrained.
Multiplayer & Synchronization - Added password-status and minimum-player filters to the Steam lobby browser. - War stats no longer show as zero; they now display correct values even for offline players. - Lords now remember meeting each player after server restarts and rejoining. - Alliance and call-to-war decisions now resolve to one shared outcome for all players.
Campaign & World - Added descriptions for campaign options in mod config. - Improved FPS on the world map.
Parties & Armies - Stop sending world AI troop XP to unrelated players while keeping each player's own and same-clan party XP up to date. - Patrol-party interactions now persist across session changes instead of disappearing. - MaximumLootersMultiplier now scales number of bandit parties (not just looters). Added a new config option to scale the size of new bandit parties. - Fixed player clan family members independently forming parties. - Companion parties now join player-led armies consistently when they finish gathering. - Players can now attack each other's caravans and parties led by companions.
Characters & Progression - A new Wanderer character is available with its added introduction text.
Kingdoms & Diplomacy - Policies are synced on kingdom creation. - Player-versus-player peace offers now need the enemy kingdom to vote before they can pass. - You cannot send another peace offer while one is still waiting for the enemy kingdom to decide. - A kingdom with one clan now opens the peace vote menu instead of auto-accepting offers. - Kingdom peace deals now resolve even when only mercenary players are in the kingdom. - Policy votes and election decisions now resolve even when only mercenary players are in a kingdom. - Kingdom decisions now keep candidate order consistent, show remaining time and outstanding voters, and resolve after a fixed 60-second timeout.
Settlements - Companions now spawn with you in settlements. - Fix an issue where a max level building could get stuck in a town's construction queue. - Players can now defend villages against armies performing an active raid.
Prisoners & Captivity - Released offline player parties no longer reappear on the map and get captured repeatedly. - All stuck prisoner heroes are repaired in the same daily update.
Quests & Conversations - Infrastructure changes related to quests. - Several named team NPCs now appear in taverns with unique outfits and dialogue.
Bug Fixes - Fixed cities and nearby parties becoming stuck after the original sally-out leader retreats and rejoins. - Fixed-town NPC data and dialogue now remain available after connecting. - Fixed parties not moving after leaving a castle until the time speed was changed. - Fixed a black screen and softlock when opening the Clan tab in a player-created kingdom. - Fixed being able to grant fiefs to companions of another player's clan. - Fixed an issue where old clients could connect to newer servers. - Fixed a crash when loading campaigns with very large numbers of mobile parties. - Fixed an issue where rescuing a companion could duplicate the companion. - Fixed lower-tier and upgrade-ready troops sometimes being impossible to withdraw from player-owned garrisons. - Fixed a crash that could occur during siege battles. - Fixed an issue where troops would not be correctly allocated to each party based on their proportion relative to the whole battle. - Fixed an issue where heroes were not captured when the settlement they are in becomes hostile. - Fixed the settlement host freezing when a populated location contains livestock. - Fixed an issue where players would get stuck on Finishing Synchronization when they try to rejoin after quitting while being in a settlement. - Fixed an issue where prisoners that were donated to a settlement would stay in the player's party. - Fixed Send Troops doing nothing after cancelling a battle simulation. - Fixed a problem where tariff income would surge for a few days after conquering a settlement from another inactive player. - Fixed workshops belonging to disconnected players using resources from warehouse inventories. - Fixed clients being able to use coop cheats for killing the enemy side when cheats are disabled on clients. - Fixed an issue where a corrupted AI party could brick a save and make it unloadable. - Fixed a client crash after auto-resolving siege battles with Send Troops. - Fixed an issue where the server would sometimes fail to load a save when a player's relationship data contained duplicates. - Fixed mismatching gold between predicted and actual change when in a kingdom with trade agreements. - Fixed an issue where players would get stuck when leaving looted villages. - Fixed family members permanently becoming stuck as prisoners. - Fixed player caravans being slower than expected and displaying a party limit of 20. - Fixed troop offers not showing on other player's screen. - Fixed companions not healing after solo encounters. - Fixed rejected peace offers leaving players stuck in the diplomacy UI. - Fixed stale formation updates moving player-led army leaders away from their gathering parties. - Fixed a client freeze that could occur mid battle. - Fixed a client freeze that could occur during deployment at the beginning of a battle. - Fixed a black screen that could appear when joining a dedicated server during an army-related kingdom decision. - Fixed an issue where the same Kingdom Policy Decision could pop up twice, with the second menu being a soft lock. - Fixed an issue where players could load different terrain in the same battle.
Other Changes - Alliance wars and related denar changes no longer repeat or diverge. - Note: This list is not exhaustive.
